2607.09322.title: LongMedBench: Benchmarking Medical Agents for Long-Horizon Clinical Decision-Making
2607.09322.paper_summary: In this work, we introduce LongMedBench, a real-world EHR-based benchmark for long-horizon clinical decision-making. Prior evaluations of LLM-based medical agents have largely emphasized short-context knowledge QA and tool use. However, real-world medical care is inherently longitudinal, and clinicians must aggregate evidence across repeated visits, tests, and evolving treatments. Therefore, long-horizon interaction is essential for realistic assessment. LongMedBench is constructed via a reproducible pipeline that integrates MIMIC-IV admission records and clinical notes into time-series event streams and long-context memory datasets, enabling long-horizon, multi-session interactions between agents and a clinical environment. It comprises 335 patients, with 19.72 inpatient visits per patient on average and 44.91 medical events per visit. Guided by the long-horizon decision process, we propose an evaluation taxonomy with three suites: fact-based QA, temporal reasoning, and long-horizon decision-making. This taxonomy measures how agents understand and leverage historical patient information over extended horizons. Our experiments show that while recent LLMs can make good use of explicit timestamps, they have challenges in implicit time inference; The RAG and agent memory system can improve the performance of information retrieval tasks, but the performance of decision-making tasks is highly dependent on the model's immediate context.
2607.09322.paper_summary_zh: 在本研究中，我們介紹了 LongMedBench，一個基於真實世界電子健康紀錄（EHR）的長期臨床決策基準。先前對基於 LLM 的醫療代理的評估主要強調短期上下文的知識問答和工具使用。然而，真實世界的醫療護理本質上是長期的，臨床醫生必須在多次就診、檢測和不斷演變的治療中整合證據。因此，長期互動對於現實評估至關重要。LongMedBench 是通過一個可重現的流程構建的，該流程將 MIMIC-IV 入院紀錄和臨床筆記整合成時間序列事件流和長上下文記憶數據集，使代理與臨床環境之間能夠進行長期的多會話互動。它包含 335 名患者，每位患者平均有 19.72 次住院就診和每次就診 44.91 次醫療事件。在長期決策過程的指導下，我們提出了一個包含三個套件的評估分類法：基於事實的問答、時間推理和長期決策。這個分類法衡量代理如何理解和利用歷史患者信息以應對延長的時間範圍。我們的實驗顯示，儘管近期的 LLM 能夠很好地利用明確的時間戳，但在隱式時間推斷方面存在挑戰；RAG 和代理記憶系統可以改善信息檢索任務的性能，但決策任務的性能高度依賴於模型的即時上下文。
